mapper.sql: P.PAYMENT_NO, P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, S.BUSINESS_NO, B.ORG_NAME, S.PLAN_TYPE, S.MONTHLY_FEE, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.START_DATE AS SUBSCRIPTION_START_DATE, S.END_DATE AS SUBSCRIPTION_END_DATE, P.AMOUNT, P.PAYMENT_METHOD, P.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, P.TRANSACTION_ID, P.PAID_AT, P.CREATED_AT AS PAYMENT_CREATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PAYMENT P JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = S.BUSINESS_NO ORDER BY CASE P.STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'PAID' THEN 2 WHEN 'REFUNDED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PAYMENT_NO DESC
SELECT FROM PAYMENT P JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = S.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.PAYMENT_NO = #{paymentNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET STATUS = 'PAID', PAID_AT = SYSDATE, TRANSACTION_ID = NVL(TRANSACTION_ID, 'TEST-' || PAYMENT_NO || '-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) WHERE PAYMENT_NO = #{paymentNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', START_DATE = SYSDATE, END_DATE = ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1), UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE PAYMENT SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE PAYMENT_NO = #{paymentNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION SET STATUS = 'CANCELED', END_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE PAYMENT SET STATUS = 'REFUNDED' WHERE PAYMENT_NO = #{paymentNo} AND STATUS = 'PAID'
UPDATE BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION SET STATUS = 'CANCELED', END_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG ( REVIEW_LOG_NO, ADMIN_MEMBER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, ACTION_TYPE, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{adminMemberNo}, 'SUBSCRIPTION', #{subscriptionNo}, #{actionType}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
